def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Dot pixels encode a ray: change the dot to 4 and extend its color
    # away from the closest 3 marker on the same row/column.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=7: continue
            g[r][c]=4
            candidates=[]
            for j in range(w):
                if grid[r][j]==3: candidates.append((abs(j-c),0,j))
            for i in range(h):
                if grid[i][c]==3: candidates.append((abs(i-r),1,i))
            if not candidates: continue
            _,axis,target=min(candidates)
            if axis==0:
                step=1 if target<c else -1
                j=c+step
                while 0<=j<w and grid[r][j]!=3:
                    g[r][j]=7; j+=step
            else:
                step=1 if target<r else -1
                i=r+step
                while 0<=i<h and grid[i][c]!=3:
                    g[i][c]=7; i+=step
    return g
